Encryption._comment: Encrypts connection passwords in connections.json. MUST be at least 32 chars. Change this before deploying, keep it out of source control, and note that changing it makes existing stored passwords unreadable (they must be re-entered).

Push._comment: Browser push notifications are disabled until these are set. Generate a pair with `npx web-push generate-vapid-keys` (Node) or the WebPush .NET library's VapidHelper.GenerateVapidKeys(), then paste the public/private key below. VapidSubject must be a mailto: or https: URL identifying the site owner, per the Web Push spec.
